sinopsis.es: Ramiro es despedido del trabajo al que perteneció gran parte de su vida. En medio de su nueva y solitaria libertad conoce a tres desocupados como él, que se reúnen para matar el tiempo y hacerse compañía mientras fantasean con vengarse de sus antiguos empleadores y buscan, un pequeño triunfo a la vez, ser felices. Cada día, todos los días.
sinopsis.en: Ramiro is fired from his job after 19 years. As he goes through his solitary days, he meets Gustavo, Ernesto and Luis Eduardo, three unemployed men like him who get together to hang around and keep each other company, while they fantasize about taking revenge on their former employers, hoping to find their happiness one small triumph at a time, as a full-time job.
